✗ Ubuntu 18.04.2 LTS: needs Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 or 26.04, or Debian 12 or 13.
  Reinstall the server with Ubuntu 26.04 from your provider's console, then run oap again. OAP doesn't upgrade an operating system in place.
! 985 MiB memory, no swap: needs swap on servers under 2 GB.
  Add a 1 GiB swap file so a memory spike slows the server instead of stopping apps.
  Fix (routine): Create /swapfile (1 GiB), enable it and add it to /etc/fstab.
